meaning: Successful public-primary-source retrieval and reading of the stated sections, not human approval, live Azure validation, or exhaustive service coverage. Local evidence IDs are not upstream recommendation IDs.

sources.title: Design review checklist for Security
sources.readScope: Complete checklist, SE:01 through SE:12. The denominator is checklist controls, not all Security guidance.

sources.title: Architecture strategies for identity and access management
sources.readScope: Determine identities and actions; role-based authorization; conditional access; critical impact accounts; identity lifecycle; nonidentity secrets; maintain an audit trail.

sources.title: Architecture strategies for protecting application secrets
sources.readScope: Complete article. Minimize secrets, isolate stores, audit access, rotate and revoke, prevent hardcoding, safely consume changed credentials.

sources.title: Architecture strategies for security incident response
sources.readScope: Complete article. Ownership, triage, containment, recovery, communication, evidence, lessons and drills.

sources.title: Architecture strategies for security testing
sources.readScope: Opening through continuous testing rhythm and start of control testing. Threat-model-driven tests, protected test assets, independent expertise, recurring and incident-triggered testing.

sources.title: Review security recommendations in Microsoft Defender for Cloud
sources.readScope: Opening, recommendation transition note, prerequisites, review page and views. The Advisor security URL redirects here. No complete Advisor recommendation-type-ID inventory is present in the inspected material.

sources.title: What is Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM)
sources.readScope: Opening, plans, availability and feature table. Free Foundational versus paid Defender CSPM; announced October 27, 2026 opt-in change.

sources.title: Use Microsoft Entra Workload ID with Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
sources.readScope: Opening, Automatic versus Standard prerequisites, limitations and supported client-library authentication. Not a claim that the CSI driver rotates source credentials.

sources.title: Use kubelogin to authenticate in Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
sources.readScope: Limitations, authentication operation and supported methods through kubeconfig conversion. Workload federation and managed identity, not preview-only noninteractive login.

sources.title: Secure traffic between pods with network policies in Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
sources.readScope: Opening retirement notices, overview, engine comparison, limitations and load-balancer interactions. Cilium Linux recommendation; NPM Windows September 30, 2026 and Linux September 30, 2028 support deadlines.

sources.title: Configure Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) nodes with an HTTP proxy
sources.readScope: Opening, limitations, configuration fields and verification of proxy variables on nodes/pods. DDoS configuration is unrelated evidence.

sources.title: Azure ABAC repository permissions in Azure Container Registry
sources.readScope: Opening, role-mode migration effects, task effects, ABAC role definitions and conditions. Legacy AcrPull/AcrPush/AcrDelete roles are not honored in ABAC mode.

sources.title: Manage emergency access admin accounts
sources.readScope: Opening through security guardrails and auditability. Two cloud-only accounts, phishing-resistant authentication, permanent active emergency role, Conditional Access exclusions, alerts and 90-day drills.

sources.title: Azure Key Vault overview
sources.readScope: Complete article. Key, secret and certificate storage, identity/access planes, monitoring and isolation.

sources.title: Azure Key Vault Managed HSM overview
sources.readScope: Complete article. Managed HSM is cryptographic key management, not a general secret/credential store.

sources.title: Azure Key Vault soft-delete
sources.readScope: Complete article. Soft-delete defaults, separate purge protection, immutable 7-90 day retention and recovery dependencies.

sources.title: Grant permission to applications to access an Azure key vault using Azure RBAC
sources.readScope: Opening, independent access planes, administrative access, application/environment isolation and beginning of built-in role table. Purge Operator covers soft-deleted vaults, not all object data-plane purges.

sources.title: Secure your Azure Key Vault
sources.readScope: Service-specific architecture, network security and identity/access sections through JIT administration. Per-application/region/environment vaults and managed identities; do not put arbitrary configuration in a secret store.

sources.title: Lock your Azure resources to protect your infrastructure
sources.readScope: Lock levels, inheritance, control-plane-only scope and operational side effects. No data-plane deletion protection.

sources.title: Soft delete for blobs to recover data
sources.readScope: Recommended configuration, retention behavior, disabling behavior, deletion/overwrite handling, restore and versioning. A setting change does not immediately erase retained objects.

sources.title: Soft delete for containers
sources.readScope: Complete article. Storage-account configuration, retention, restore scope and existing retention surviving disablement.

sources.title: Grant limited access to data with shared access signatures (SAS)
sources.readScope: Types, authorization, token visibility, use cases and best practices through start-time discussion. SAS expiration-policy-specific article takes precedence over older warning-only overview text.

sources.title: Configure an expiration policy for shared access signatures (SAS)
sources.readScope: Policy behavior, Log/Block actions, exclusions, user-delegation key lifetime, File Sync minimum interval and configuration. No Log Analytics KQL is presented as ARG.

sources.title: Require secure transfer to ensure secure connections
sources.readScope: Complete article. REST HTTPS rejection and independent Azure Files per-protocol encryption settings.

sources.title: SFTP support for Azure Blob Storage
sources.readScope: Opening, hierarchical namespace, identity model, authentication, container permissions, ACL evaluation and home directory. ACLs cannot narrow already-granted container permissions.

sources.title: Authorize SFTP access to blobs using Microsoft Entra ID
sources.readScope: Opening, benefits, authentication overview and OpenSSH certificate/client prerequisites. Removes the obsolete local-users-only assertion.

sources.title: NFS file shares in Azure Files
sources.readScope: Opening, supported features, resource-provider models, encryption and authentication/network access. NFS encryption in transit is supported; Kerberos/ACLs are not.

sources.title: Architecture best practices for Azure App Service (Web Apps)
sources.readScope: Security workload-design checklist and Security configuration table only. Service-specific controls do not fully cover workload-wide SE controls.

sources.title: Use Key Vault references as app settings
sources.readScope: Opening, managed identity access, network restrictions, rotation/cache behavior, references and slots, Files and Application Insights considerations. Reference refresh is not source credential rotation.

sources.title: Configure an App Service app
sources.readScope: App settings and general settings. HTTPS-only redirects HTTP, minimum TLS and remote-debugging controls. Does not establish exact ARG field casing or table exposure.

sources.title: Secure your domain with TLS/SSL
sources.readScope: Certificate binding, testing and FAQs. A secured label does not prove certificate validity; HTTPS redirect and TLS behavior.

sources.title: What is Azure Web Application Firewall on Azure Application Gateway?
sources.readScope: Overview, policy associations, rules, bot protection, modes and monitoring. Detection logs without blocking; tune then use Prevention. Front Door queries do not assess Application Gateway.
